title: Council Order 0015480: information required for a home care facility; Care Occupancy B3 and fire alarm and sprinkler question under ABC 2014
jurisdiction: Alberta; accredited municipality not named in the order (respondent)
code_edition: Alberta Building Code 2014 (Division C 2.2.10.8; Care Occupancy as stated in the decision)
document_date: 2017-11-15 (Council Order 0015480); the underlying order is dated 2017-08-16; development permit application dated 2017-05-15 (as cited)

facts.text: The order issued 2017-08-16 under section 43 of the Safety Codes Act and ABC 2014 Division C 2.2.10.8 required information adequate to determine compliance; the Tribunal varied it to require information adequate to determine compliance or to allow the AHJ to consider an application.
The Panel records that the 2014 ABC introduced Care Occupancy and that the 2006 ABC did not recognise the level of care provided.

The residents are described as ambulatory and cognitive and able to self-evacuate; the Panel found the residence as proposed to be a B3 care facility requiring a fire alarm and sprinkler system or equivalent.

The Panel encouraged the appellant to contact the building safety codes officer about variance or alternative-solution routes for the fire alarm, sprinkler and fire-separation concerns, and said professional help may be needed.
